steps.what: Read the assigned economic document and identify the exact source tables, reference records and review scope in {DOCS}
Compare exact reported values and reference identifiers with the selected source cells and catalogue records in {DOCS}
Review documents written by others for economic reasoning, identification, assumptions, limitations and what the original sources actually support
Write actual review comments in {DOCS} and check that each accurately states the issue and its evidence
Save comments in the same {DOCS} review file without publishing or sending the review

tasks.design: Configure exact source-cell and reference checks plus fixed comment references in {DOCS}. The economist reads the entire document and original evidence and writes the substantive review; deterministic matches establish neither sound reasoning nor citation support.
tasks.previous_blocker: Literal value and reference checking can require repeated manual comparison.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked fields and exact checks can isolate mismatches.
tasks.still_hard: Economic identification, assumptions and overclaimed conclusions require expert reading.
tasks.human_edge: The economist recognises a technically consistent number attached to an unsupported conclusion.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for review confidentiality and source access; national consultation where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact source-value and identifier checks can support document review without evaluating economic reasoning.

assumptions: Representative review actually includes manual value/reference checking and written comments. Authors supply existing documents and sources; s1 counts full scope reading, selection of exact cells/identifiers and missing-source recovery. Unresolved references remain unresolved, not invented or semantically accepted because an identifier resolves.

S2 explicitly performs only literal comparisons. Non-structured tables require manual checking, not free extraction. S3 retains complete substantive and source-support review. S4 captures all comments and checks their meaning; only exact selected page, paragraph and source references default.

Native configuration first; existing checks earn no new gain. No confidential review material is uploaded to a model, and no generative peer-review or evaluation loop is proposed. Ordinary same-system save is negligible, minimum share 1 fully retained and ungated without self-approval. A real review delivery or approval of another author's document is separate if actually required.
Shares are hypotheses, not measured review baselines; the author's source-production work is existing unchanged work, not a new free requirement.
research_questions: Which literal comparisons remain manual after native review features are used?

already_counted.description: Scope/source capture, full substantive review and meaningful comments/checks remain.

incremental.description: Maintain exact reference checks and test them after source-format changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=76.2, gross=23.8; upkeep 3 gives net 20.8. Low zero for narrative-only documents or reviews already using effective literal checks, where no additional checker is introduced. Substantive evaluation never shrinks.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Locate and read the actual economic evidence, model outputs and client question in {DOCS}
Provide advice and consultation on economic relationships to businesses, public and private agencies, and other employers, explaining assumptions and uncertainty and answering questions
Write the actual working advisory brief in {DOCS}, capturing the advice and qualifications and checking all claims against the evidence
Save the working advisory brief in the same {DOCS} file without issuing it

tasks.design: Configure original-evidence links and exact source fields in the {DOCS} advisory brief. The economist interprets the evidence, consults with the client and writes and checks the advice; no economic recommendation or client instruction is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Consultation can involve repeated source retrieval and reference entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document search and fixed-reference fields can remove repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Economic relationships may be context dependent and uncertain.
tasks.human_edge: The economist explains what the evidence does and does not imply for the client's question.

ambition.what: No new financial or policy decision authority.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for client-source access and confidentiality; national consultation where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-linked advisory templates can reduce reference repetition while economic interpretation and consultation remain human.

assumptions: Representative formal consultation includes an actual working advisory brief; it does not invent a report after every conversation. If advice is only oral, remove that writing and recalculate. Research/model owners produce existing evidence and outputs in ordinary analysis; s1 reads and verifies them and obtains missing context manually.

S3 captures all advice meaning and qualifications; only exact topic/source/period references default. There is no free structured consultation record or generated causal conclusion. Native configuration first; existing links and templates earn no new gain.

The save is negligible, minimum share 1 fully retained and ungated without self-approval. It does not deliver a formal written opinion or enact a client decision. An actual issued brief requires its real final-version authority and separate send; no new client or reviewer work is assumed free.
Shares are provisional active work, not measured consulting baselines. Original economic analysis is unchanged baseline work, not a claimed automation gain.
research_questions: Which source-navigation and reference-entry actions genuinely remain repeated?

already_counted.description: Evidence reading, consultation and all advisory meaning capture/checks remain.

incremental.description: Check advisory source fields and links after evidence-library changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=93.15, gross=6.85; upkeep 2 gives net 4.85. Low zero when the consultation already has direct source access and reference fields, so add no duplicate configuration. Interpretation and conversation retain their full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Formulate economic recommendations policies and plans

steps.what: Verify actual economic source outputs and objectives and capture selected scenarios, units, periods and comparison formulas in {SPREADSHEET}
Transfer exact selected scenario results and source references into the {SPREADSHEET} options table
Calculate explicit scenario differences and selected sensitivity comparisons in {SPREADSHEET}
Formulate recommendations, policies, or plans to solve economic problems or interpret markets, weighing actual evidence, uncertainty and trade-offs
Write the actual recommendation and rationale in {DOCS}

loop.purpose: Draft wording around the economist's already chosen recommendation
loop.input: Chosen recommendation, rationale, limits and traceable comparisons
loop.output: Narrative with source pointers and no added policy or causal assertion
loop.check: Economist compares every claim, number, qualification and commitment against original outputs and selected reasoning in s6
loop.stop: Unsupported conclusion, missing source or changed recommendation returns to human reasoning and manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native tables and templates handle numbers; only variable explanatory prose needs bounded wording assistance

steps.what: Complete and correct the full recommendation document against original model outputs, assumptions and economic reasoning
Save the working recommendation in the same {DOCS} file without issuing or implementing it

tasks.design: Configure exact scenario-result import and explicit comparisons in {SPREADSHEET}, then offer a bounded {DOCS} wording draft for the economist's chosen recommendation. The economist supplies the reasoning and completes all claims against original sources; software makes no economic policy decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Options documents can require repeated scenario transfer, comparison arithmetic and explanation writing.
tasks.enabler_now: Native imports, explicit formulas and constrained wording assistance can support these distinct operations.
tasks.still_hard: Economic identification, distributional trade-offs and unmodelled uncertainty remain judgement problems.
tasks.human_edge: The economist knows when a numerical preference is not a defensible recommendation.

ambition.what: No policy adoption or investment decision is automated.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-8 for economic-source access and confidentiality review; national consultation where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact scenario transfers and explicit comparisons are deterministic, while economic recommendation choices and qualifications require human reasoning.

assumptions: Representative episode formulates a recommendation using actual existing model outputs and manual comparison tables. Analysis owners produce those outputs in existing research work, whose design and runtime are unchanged and earn no saving. S1 counts verification, objective interpretation, scenario selection and all unit/period/formula capture; missing or incomparable results require manual analysis rather than a free clean scenario feed.

S2 explicitly imports and s3 explicitly computes only selected comparisons. Native functionality first; existing scripts or comparison tables earn no new gain. No new econometric model, forecast or causal inference is silently generated.

S4 retains actual recommendation formation, s5 retains edits and fallback and s6 all original-source and reasoning checks. Native templates precede a wording model. Actual shared advisory or research writing is counted once across tasks.

Ordinary authoring is not self-approval. Same-system save is negligible, minimum share 1 fully retained and ungated. Actual policy approval, external delivery or implementation requires its real authority and separate action after the final document exists. Shares are hypotheses, not measured economic-planning baselines.
unknowns: Observed narrative edit and fallback effort
research_questions: Which comparison-table operations remain manual after native analysis features are used?

already_counted.description: Input/rule capture, economic recommendation decisions, draft edits and full original-source checks remain.

incremental.description: Maintain scenario mappings and sample source support after formula/template/model changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=64, gross=36; upkeep 4 gives net 32. Conservative case: novel scenarios require full manual prose and only 7 transfer/comparison points are avoidable, giving 7-4=3. Economic choices and full reasoning checks remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise research and student study projects

steps.what: Locate and read current research milestones, student submissions and study questions in {PROJECT}
Review actual economic research design, analysis and student reasoning against the study aims and original evidence
Supervise research projects and students' study projects through actual discussion, feedback and resolution of methodological questions
Write actual required project feedback and next-work references in {PROJECT}, checking all methodological meaning
Save the feedback entry in the same {PROJECT} record

tasks.design: Configure current project/submission links and exact project references in {PROJECT}. The economist reads the work, evaluates its reasoning, discusses it and writes and checks the feedback; no research or student assessment is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision may repeat navigation and project-reference entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native project links and fixed fields can remove that repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding a methodological error and guiding the learner require personal judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The economist identifies what the researcher understands and what they still need to work out.

ambition.what: No automated student evaluation or project approval.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for research/student access and national consultation where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: current-submission links and exact project references can reduce supervision administration while substantive feedback remains human.

assumptions: Representative supervision episode has an actual required feedback entry, not an invented report after every conversation. Researchers and students produce existing submissions during their unchanged research work; s1 verifies version and context and s2 reads original work fully. Missing evidence is obtained manually.

S4 captures every feedback statement and next-work decision; only exact project and submission references default. If no feedback record is actually required, remove it and estimate that episode separately. Native configuration first; existing links earn no new gain.

Ordinary same-system save is negligible, minimum share 1 fully retained and ungated without author self-approval. It sends no assignment notice and grants no grade, project release or study approval. Any actual formal decision or send must be its own real authorized action.
Shares are provisional active work, not measured supervision times. Student/researcher work and participation are unchanged baseline labour, not new free work.
research_questions: Which project-reference operations remain repeated during actual supervision?

already_counted.description: Context reading, full work review, discussion and all feedback meaning checks remain.

incremental.description: Check project and submission-reference mappings after project changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=96.1, gross=3.9; upkeep 1 gives net 2.9. Low zero when current submissions and references already link directly, so no duplicate configuration is introduced. All substantive supervision remains.

Trace narrative assertions to original outputs
Measure active preparation apart from model runtime
